highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.159.0 adds experimental image comparison APIs and fixes runtime-effect initialization and Windows image-decoding crashes.
highlights_body: A separate SkiaSharp.Testing package supports tolerance-based image comparisons and visual diagnostics. GPU texture-edge sampling also changes, while Linux x86 native assets are removed.

breaking.title: Move Linux x86 deployments to a supported architecture
breaking.body: Linux x86 native assets are no longer built or included in NuGet packages. Move applications deploying to linux-x86 to a supported Linux architecture before upgrading.

bullets.detail: SkiaSharp.Testing compares SKImage, SKBitmap and SKPixmap inputs with channel tolerances, masks, mismatch budgets and error metrics, and creates caller-owned difference images. The assembly is experimental; opt in by suppressing diagnostic SKIA4001 with NoWarn or a pragma.

bullets.lead: Windows x64 decoder recovery no longer terminates the process
bullets.detail: Fixes crashes when libjpeg or libpng uses longjmp for error recovery in clang-built Windows x64 natives, including malformed JPEGs passed to SKCodec.Create and PDF output using lazily decoded non-JPEG images. Other Windows architectures and MSVC builds are unchanged.

bullets.lead: Uniform buffers start and reset to zero
bullets.detail: SKRuntimeEffectUniforms no longer exposes uninitialized values on creation or after Reset(). Reset clears the existing buffer in place instead of allocating a new native block and managed wrapper, including when uniforms are reused for meshes.

bullets.lead: Filtered GPU sampling stays inside texture subsets
bullets.detail: Ganesh sampling uses an inward inset to avoid including undefined texels beyond subset edges. Texture-edge pixels may change; this is not a CPU or Graphite rendering change.

bullets.lead: Tizen CPU blur selection takes effect
bullets.detail: Tizen now applies its intended blur configuration to Skia itself, selecting the existing ThreeBoxApprox/Tent paths instead of the shader-based Gaussian candidate. Blur pixels and performance may differ; Tizen rendering and performance were not measured in the source change.

contributor_summaries.taublast: Corrected uniform initialization and in-place reset behavior, and disposed test data snapshots.
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Restored the Uno Gallery to the Windows sample solution.
contributor_summaries.SimonCropp: Fixed Windows x64 crashes during JPEG and PNG decoder error recovery.
